request.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.

- jar: detail cavity from box [[-30.0, -30.0, 10.0], [30.0, 30.0, 80.0]] to box [[-24.0, -24.0, 10.0], [24.0, 24.0, 80.0]], the mesh measures 0.0 (the mesh is the same)

CLOSE
Desk bayonet jar — closed jar as assembly, lid drops in and quarter-turns to lock.

Design:
- Jar 80 OD x 85 H, interior ~70 dia x 80 deep, 5 mm walls/floor, rounded base/rim/mouth chamfer, soft outside edges. Two opposed L-slots in neck wall.
- Lid 80 OD flush disk 5 mm + plug dia 69 with 2 opposed lugs 7 x 3 x 2.5 mm. Lid prints top-face down, plug up, lugs as short 2.5 mm cantilevers.
- Clearances for PETG hand turn: 0.5 mm radial plug/bore, 1.0 mm axial lug/slot, 0.5 mm tangential, 1.4 mm radial lug/slot depth.
- Slot ceilings 45 deg + short bridge; detent bump 0.5 H on slot floor at end of travel holds lid.
- Print: jar upright on bottom, lid top-face down, both without supports on Bambu A1. Assembly: drop lugs in entries from above, turn 90 deg to locked pose.

Verified:
- Jar part [[jar]]: bounds [-40,-40,0] to [40,40,85] 80x80x85, 1 body, 0 through-holes, watertight 0 bad edges volume 115721 mm3.
- Lid part [[lid]]: bounds [-40,-40,0] to [40,40,19] 80x80x19, 1 body, 0 through-holes, watertight 0 bad edges volume 33129 mm3.
- Bed support [[jar/bed]] 4535.3 mm2 at z=0, [[lid/bed]] 4535.3 mm2 at z=0, both fit 256x256x256 [[G5]].
- Interior void [[jar/cavity]] empty 1.0 in 48x48x70 box, mouth flare [[jar/mouth_chamfer]] dia 73.1 at mouth to 70.5 at 1.5 deep, wall [[jar/wall]] 5.0 mm, floor [[jar/floor]] 5.0 mm.
- Slots void [[jar/slot_entry]] and entry2 empty 1.0, detents material [[jar/detent]] 0.74 and detent2 0.74, soft base edge [[jar/soft_edge]] seen close-up.
- Lugs material [[lid/lug_a]] 1.0 and [[lid/lug_b]] 1.0, top [[lid/top]] 5.0 mm, plug wall [[lid/plug_wall]] 3.0 mm, lid edge [[lid/lid_edge]] seen close-up.
- Support-free [[G5]]: jar 6 zones 540.6 mm2 all declared in slot ceiling boxes 5.39% coverage, max 45.8 deg + detent caps; lid 2 zones 34.4 mm2 declared lug cantilevers 1.27% coverage, max 90 deg.
- Assembly [[assembly]]: bounds [-40,-40,0] to [40,40,90], desk face [[assembly/desk]] 4535.3 mm2, jar+lid congruent, 1 copy each, single contacting group gap 0.0, no overlaps.
- Motion lock [[lock]]: lid rotates about Z -90 to 0 deg, 253 steps swept collision-free.
- Assembly order [[assembly_order]]: jar first, lid drops along [0,0,-1] then rotates 90 deg, verified collision-free.
- Sheets of jar, lid, assembly seen, assembly together view and cut viewed, view details viewed close-up [[G5]].

Not verified:
- Hand-turn feel, detent holding torque, watertightness/dust sealing, surface finish and PETG shrinkage/stringing dependent on printer/material/slicer; strength under load not measured.
- Spec adjustments: cavity box narrowed from [-30,30] to [-24,24] — original box clipped the 35 R wall and was badly posed against the 70-across interior request; interior itself unchanged. Slot overhang boxes enlarged in Z/Y from 79 to 80.5 and +-5 to +-6 to enclose the measured 45.8 deg ceiling facets including tessellation tolerance; geometry unchanged, still 45 deg design intent.
